name: offline PCM preservation
description: Render actual generated fixture payloads through virtual output.
given: A fresh fixture directory containing owned signed 16/24/32-bit PCM.
when: Run the renderer with block sizes 1, 64, 256, and 1024.
then: Capture identical numeric samples and frame counts without modifying the input.

name: repeatable output faults
description: Inject deterministic faults at exact output frame positions.
given: A boundary fixture and a versioned fault schedule.
when: Run each short-write, zero-progress, underrun, backend, malformed-chunk, and stale-epoch case twice.
then: Preserve identical partial captures and semantic events with the expected terminal outcome.

name: immutable qualification run
description: Keep earlier evidence intact when an output directory already exists.
when: Run qualification again with that same destination.
then: Reject the request without replacing the earlier evidence.

name: evidence tamper rejection
description: Verify evidence with a fresh read of every declared artifact.
given: A completed real offline run with captured hashes and provenance.
when: Modify a result file after qualification.
then: Fail evidence validation and retain the artifacts for inspection.
